name: Document (A4)
description: Structured A4 / printable document format / 210 × 297 mm (8.27 × 11.69 inches), as defined by the ISO 216 international standard
prompt:
Create a complete A4 portrait worksheet as one standalone HTML document — return only the HTML.
Pages are sequential <div class="page"> blocks, each 210 × 297 mm (width: 210mm; min-height: 297mm). Multi-page is normal when the content needs it — never squeeze content to fit one page.
Composition: use the full page width; compact multi-column card grids within sections where natural; dense, adult print typography.
